notes.title: 911 Operator Final Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Operators![/h2]

911 Operator has been released over 4 years ago. A lot of you are still playing the game, and some of you discover it for the very first time. That's why we have decided to come back to you with this one last final update! We realize that some of you have problems with map download, especially in certain areas around the world. That's why we have decided to add over 20 new maps to the base game: 

[list]
[*] Buenos Aires
[*] Madrid
[*] Kanton
[*] Jakarta
[*] Kyiv
[*] Amsterdam
[*] Toronto
[*] Ankara
[*] Saint Petersburg
[*] Santiago
[*] Bogota
[*] Vienna
[*] Singapore
[*] Chengdu
[*] Nanjing
[*] Sydney
[*] Shinjuku
[*] Rio de Janeiro
[*] Melbourne
[*] Brussels
[*] Manila
[*] Stockholm
[/list]
Other than that we have changed some of the spelling errors and other minor bugs, that were kept unattended over the years. With those final changes, we consider 911 Operator a complete game. Maybe it's time to play once again through the main campaign? 

[h2]Something Ends, Something Begins[/h2]
Although we now consider our work on 911 Operator to be over, the team that has brought you 911 Operator and 112 Operator is working hard on a brand new game! It might be a bit of a surprise, as it isn't an emergency simulator this time, but a post-apocalyptic city-builder strategy game. What stays the same then? We are still committed to creating the best games played on real-world maps. That's why your job in this new title will be to build a settlement and protect it from deadly hordes of infected. It's your choice where you want to play and how you want to achieve your victory. 

By-the-way, this game was introduced by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1570180/112_Operator__The_Last_Duty/]THE LAST DUTY DLC[/url] to 112 Operator. Check how the story starts, and what happened to our Operator!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gameops/infection-free-zone-city-survival-with-real-maps?ref=81vu4y]CLICK HERE[/url] to support the Kickstarter campaign for [b]Infection Free Zone[/b]. We will be extremely happy to have you on board! It's our main goal to keep the community happy with the new direction we are taking, so your feedback is going to be well appreciated. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465460/Infection_Free_Zone/

Best regards,
Jutsu Games Team

notes.title: Rustler - Early Access Release and Loyalty Discount
notes.notes:
Dear all!
We are happy to announce the launch of the Early Access version of Rustler!

Owners of this game will get the 25% Loyalty DISCOUNT when buying Rustler!
 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/844260][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25944205/fa8c36f50a21edae36bee4e0f8a1dab3d046ec0a.png[/img][/url]

Experience feudal injustice, witch-hunting and join big tournaments. Meet valiant, yet incredibly stupid knights. Complete a wide variety of twisted missions and quests... or don’t give a damn about the plot and bring mayhem in the villages and cities. Choose to go on foot or by a stolen horse. Fight with a sword or pick a fancy automatic crossbow. All that spiced up with an inappropriate Monty Python inspired sense of humor!

There's no time to wait - discount is available only till February 24th! Buy Rustler now and ride Your Horse! 🐴

https://store.steampowered.com/app/844260

notes.title: New update and sale
notes.notes:
Hi, we just did a couple of important improvements to the Operator's performance. Check it out, especially if you had some problems with calls loading time!

BTW, all the DLCs are currently on sale, so grab them and get ready for some new dramatic calls!

notes.title: Game update, new DLC + GIVEAWAY!
notes.notes:
[h1]Our new DLC is just around the corner! [/h1]
It includes fresh calls, new Career cities, events and a whole new mechanic - search for missing children, stolen cars and many, many more! Check it out here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/606971/911_Operator__Search__Rescue/] 911 Operator - Search & Rescue[/url], going live on [b]July 26th[/b]!

[h1]Facebook Giveaway[/h1]
To celebrate the DLC’s launch, we’re throwing a [b]giveaway[/b] on our  [url=https://www.facebook.com/GamesOperators/] Facebook page[/url]. Make sure to like it and stay tuned to win Search and Rescue codes!

[h1]Base game update[/h1]
We've also updated the base game, fixing some bugs and adding features like sliders for dialogue options, new tips, saving units' positions after deployment and more!

notes.title: New forum for mobile and console version of 911 Operator
notes.notes:
Hi,
We just launched a new place when you can discuss 911 Operator. The forum is made mainly for console and mobile players, but but PC players are also welcome.

Here is the link:
http://jutsugames.com/911forum

We'll be still monitoring and reply you on Steam Discussion as well.

Also, remember that 911 Operator soon will be available on Xbox One, Android and Apple's devices. The launch of the mobile version is scheduled for 09.11 (November 9th).

notes.title: 911 Operator is now in Pre-Release version!
notes.notes:
Dear all beta-testing operators and dispatchers, our game is now available in pre-release version! If you happen to find some last-minute bugs, please visit the Steam discussion thread and share it! There you can also find the log of recent changes 

We also encourage you to publish your gameplays online, its totally OK now :)

BTW, if you happen to be at GDC in San Francisco, come and meet us there! Our head designer, Bartek Gajewski will be there!

Stay tuned for the final release and the game premiere on Feb 24th!
